column5: BEST-VERIFIED SECTION IN THE CASINO: 6 of 9 frames verified `match` against measured DOM, not by eye - board 9163-4529 (tile 103.047 vs Figma 103.0408, gap 11.437 vs 11.449, radius 5.152 and border 3.4347 exact, ring colours #FF574A bomb / #17F9B4 gem on a constant #001615 tile, the frame's 150%/135.48% BOMB_CROP rather than a plain cover, committed gem.png/bomb.png and one extracted tile-bolt.svg), mobile board 9163-6955 holding the identical 0.1111 gap/tile ratio, bet panel Advanced-off 9163-7155 (every label verbatim, Mines: is now the frame's combobox and the DOM reports no input[type=range], CTA 324x52 #56C7F3 radius 16), Advanced-Auto 9163-7972 (all six advanced labels), and both mobile panel states 9163-8481 / 9163-8621 including the frame's CTA-above-toggle inversion. The 4 page frames are `partial` for reasons already on record: 9003-110110 tablet A is the REJECTED rival of B (A's 708-wide letterbox board with Manual/Auto above the CTA contradicts both B and mobile, so only B's shape was built) and 9163-5572's own info-block title and card art read 'Dice' - designer leftovers deliberately not reproduced, along with its clipped Dice trio below the frame bottom. ★ TWO RENDERED-BUT-WRONG CONTROLS keep this off `done`, and both are elements the frames specify. (1) The frame's 'Potential Profit:' field quotes a number the rail does not pay: MinesGame.tsx:150 floors at *98 (2%) while the live POINTS rail _shared/mines.ts:126 uses MINES_EDGE_BPS=9500 (5%) - at 3 mines / 3 reveals the panel shows 1.46x and the server pays 1.4188x, so a 1,000-point stake returns 42 points less than displayed, quoted high at bet-sizing time then silently corrected mid-round. Five edge numbers exist in total (client 2%, points 5%, legacy game-settlement default 0.05, dead gridGamesService 0.02) and the ADMIN key mines_house_edge (default 0.03) is read by NOTHING. (2) The frame's 'Grid Size:' control offers 25 / 36 / 49 / Custom and the choice is silently dropped - MinesGame passes gridSize but pointsGameService.ts never forwards it, so selecting 36/49/64 leaves a 25-tile SERVER board behind a larger client board and every tile index >= 25 fails with an opaque 'Failed to reveal tile'. ★ ALSO a second live Mines UI, MinefieldPro.tsx, is still mounted in Play.tsx and PlayNewReleases.tsx carrying the same 2% hardcode under a comment falsely claiming it matches the server.
